learning_objectives: Explain that green plants make their own food by photosynthesis
Identify the raw materials: carbon dioxide from air, water from soil, sunlight and chlorophyll
State that glucose (food) and oxygen are produced and write the word equation
visual_style: Clean flat vector illustration with bold dark outlines, simple bright greens, yellows and blues, on a pure white background, textbook-diagram style with no text.

scenes.title: पौधे का भोजन कहाँ से?
scenes.title_en: Where does a plant get food?
scenes.learning_goal: Hook: we eat food, but a potted plant never eats yet still grows; plants make their own food.
scenes.visual_idea: A child eating a plate of food next to a green potted plant growing on a sunny windowsill, with the sun visible outside the window.

scenes.title: भोजन बनाने की सामग्री
scenes.learning_goal: Plants take water from soil through roots and carbon dioxide from air through tiny pores (stomata) in leaves.
scenes.visual_idea: A whole plant diagram showing roots in soil with blue arrows of water moving up the stem, and grey arrows of carbon dioxide entering a leaf, with a magnified circle inset of a leaf surface showing stomata.

scenes.title: सूर्य का प्रकाश और क्लोरोफिल
scenes.learning_goal: The green pigment chlorophyll in leaves captures sunlight energy to make food.
scenes.visual_idea: A large green leaf with yellow sun rays falling on it from a sun in the corner, and a magnified circle inset showing leaf cells filled with small green chlorophyll-containing bodies.

scenes.title: भोजन और ऑक्सीजन बने
scenes.learning_goal: Photosynthesis produces glucose (food, stored as starch) and releases oxygen into the air.
scenes.visual_idea: A leaf in sunlight with a small sugar-cube-like food symbol inside it, arrows showing food moving to stem and roots, and blue bubbles of oxygen leaving the leaf into the air.

scenes.title: सार: शब्द समीकरण
scenes.learning_goal: One-line recap: carbon dioxide + water, in sunlight with chlorophyll, gives glucose + oxygen.
scenes.visual_idea: Board summary layout: icons of a carbon dioxide cloud plus a water drop, an arrow with a small sun and green leaf above it, leading to a food symbol plus oxygen bubbles.
